title: Pan-Seared Chicken & Garlic Herb Orzo
steps: Melt Base 1 and Flavor A in a hot skillet with 2 tablespoons of broth.
Sear chicken slices until golden brown on both sides.
Add dry orzo and remaining broth, cover, and simmer for 12 minutes until tender and glossy.

title: Smoky Adobo Ground Meat & Black Bean Tacos
steps: Brown ground meat in a skillet, draining excess fat if necessary.
Drop in Base 2, Flavor D, and black beans with 2 tablespoons of water.
Simmer for 5 minutes until reduced into a rich taco filling; serve in warm tortillas.

title: Turkey & Green Herb Breakfast Hash
steps: Sauté diced potatoes in a skillet until crisp and golden.
Toss in shredded turkey, Base 3, and Flavor A, melting them into a vibrant herb glaze.
Make two wells in the hash and crack the eggs into them; cover until whites are set.

title: Ginger-Scallion Egg Drop Rice Bowl
steps: Simmer broth, Base 1, and Flavor B in a small pot until dissolved.
Drizzle in beaten eggs slowly while stirring gently to form delicate ribbons; garnish with scallions.

title: Velvet Garlic Cream Chicken & Rice Skillet
steps: Pan-sear chicken cubes in a skillet until fully cooked through.
Add Base 4, Flavor C, and warm water, whisking into a velvety spiced cream sauce.
Toss in cooked rice until thoroughly coated and heated through.
